 8	import org.springframework.http.server.reactive.ServerHttpRequest;
 9	import org.springframework.http.server.reactive.ServerHttpResponse;
 10	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 11	import org.springframework.web.server.ServerWebExchange;
 12	import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
 13	
 14	@Component
 15	public class AuthenticationFilter extends AbstractGatewayFilterFactory<AuthenticationFilter.Config> {
 16	
 17	 private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
 18	
 19	 public AuthenticationFilter(JwtUtil jwtUtil) {
 20	 super(Config.class);
 21	 this.jwtUtil = jwtUtil;
 22	 }
 23	
 24	 @Override
 25	 public GatewayFilter apply(Config config) {
 26	 return (exchange, chain) -> {
 27	 ServerHttpRequest request = exchange.getRequest();
 28	 
 29	 // Skip authentication for auth endpoints
 30	 if (isAuthMicroservice(request)) {
 31	 return chain.filter(exchange);
 32	 }
 33	
 34	 // Check for token in headers
 35	 if (!request.getHeaders().containsKey(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION)) {
 36	 return onError(exchange, "No authorization header", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
 37	 }
 38	
 39	 String authHeader = request.getHeaders().getFirst(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION);
 40	 String token = null;
 41	 
 42	 if (authHeader != null && authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
 43	 token = authHeader.substring(7);
 44	 }
 45	 
 46	 if (token == null) {
 47	 return onError(exchange, "Invalid auth token format", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
 48	 }
 49	
 50	 // Validate JWT token
 51	 if (!jwtUtil.validateToken(token)) {
 52	 return onError(exchange, "Invalid or expired token", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
 53	 }
 54	
 55	 // Extract user id and add as header for downstream services
 56	 String userId = jwtUtil.getUsernameFromToken(token);
 57	 ServerHttpRequest modifiedRequest = exchange.getRequest().mutate()
 58	 .header("X-User-ID", userId)
 59	 .build();
 60	 
 61	 return chain.filter(exchange.mutate().request(modifiedRequest).build());
 62	 };
 63	 }

 66	 // Path patterns that don't require authentication
 67	 String path = request.getURI().getPath();
 68	 return path.contains("/users/signup") || 
 69	 path.contains("/users/login") || 
 70	 path.contains("/users/verify-otp") ||
 71	 path.contains("/users/refresh");
 72	 }

 74	 private Mono<Void> onError(ServerWebExchange exchange, String err, HttpStatus httpStatus) {
 75	 ServerHttpResponse response = exchange.getResponse();
 76	 response.setStatusCode(httpStatus);
 77	 return response.setComplete();

 14	@Component
 15	public class AuthenticationFilter extends AbstractGatewayFilterFactory<AuthenticationFilter.Config> {
 16	
 17	 private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;
 18	
 19	 public AuthenticationFilter(JwtUtil jwtUtil) {
 20	 super(Config.class);
 21	 this.jwtUtil = jwtUtil;
 22	 }
 23	
 24	 @Override
 25	 public GatewayFilter apply(Config config) {
 26	 return (exchange, chain) -> {
 27	 ServerHttpRequest request = exchange.getRequest();
 28	 
 29	 // Skip authentication for auth endpoints
 30	 if (isAuthMicroservice(request)) {
 31	 return chain.filter(exchange);
 32	 }
 33	
 34	 // Check for token in headers
 35	 if (!request.getHeaders().containsKey(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION)) {
 36	 return onError(exchange, "No authorization header", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
 37	 }
 38	
 39	 String authHeader = request.getHeaders().getFirst(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION);
 40	 String token = null;
 41	 
 42	 if (authHeader != null && authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
 43	 token = authHeader.substring(7);
 44	 }
 45	 
 46	 if (token == null) {
 47	 return onError(exchange, "Invalid auth token format", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
 48	 }
 49	
 50	 // Validate JWT token
 51	 if (!jwtUtil.validateToken(token)) {
 52	 return onError(exchange, "Invalid or expired token", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
 53	 }
 54	
 55	 // Extract user id and add as header for downstream services
 56	 String userId = jwtUtil.getUsernameFromToken(token);
 57	 ServerHttpRequest modifiedRequest = exchange.getRequest().mutate()
 58	 .header("X-User-ID", userId)
 59	 .build();
 60	 
 61	 return chain.filter(exchange.mutate().request(modifiedRequest).build());
 62	 };
 63	 }

 66	 // Path patterns that don't require authentication
